notes.content: An undated typewritten letter page addressed to Murre, with three body paragraphs. Paragraph 1 apologizes for errors induced by sketchy notes and oral explanations. Paragraph 2 gives a proposed counterexample to 1.16 and 3.6 and says the proofs of 3.7 and 3.8 break down. Paragraph 3 questions 6.4 without regularity of D_i and proposes a normal-crossings/tame-ramification formulation using étale-local irreductible components. This account reports the page; the numbered results and proposed generalization are unverified background. No signature, date, letterhead, stamp, diagram, free-standing drawing, display equation, or authorial foliation appears on this page.
